Author: SheepGoMeh
Name: SoundBringers
Description:
Plays a second mix of the game's audio, with its own volume for BGM, Sound Effects, Voice, System Sounds, Ambient Sounds and Performance, to an output device of your choice, so your stream can hear what you don't. Requires a virtual audio cable driver (for example VB-Cable), which this plugin does not install.
Open the settings with /soundbringers
Punchline: A second game audio mix for your stream.
